texts.facts: The complainant has lodged a complaint / FIR, citing serious negligence.
texts.arguments: Issuance of show-cause notice clearly indicates that petitioners had full knowledge that in absence of such basic facilities, there is every chance of happening of any incident which might put the life of students in danger.
